psychology.secret: Malika Akerblom-Manu murdered their mentor to take their position and contacts. It was staged as a job gone wrong. The guilt has calcified into something worse than guilt.

example_lines: "The best disguise is being exactly who they expect to see."

interpersonal_modes.employers: Guarded respect. They pay, the job gets done. Anything beyond that is liability.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Competitive but reliable. Will challenge decisions but never abandon the team.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Default suspicion, scaled by context. Everyone is a potential threat until proven otherwise.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Cold and efficient. Emotion is a liability in combat. The response is mechanical until the threat is resolved.

stress_responses.low: Becomes more talkative, working through scenarios verbally.
stress_responses.medium: Physical agitation â€” pacing, fidgeting, compulsive equipment checks.
stress_responses.high: Hyper-focused tunnel vision. Peripheral concerns disappear. Only the threat exists.
stress_responses.critical: Shutdown. Freezes for 2-3 seconds while the system resets, then acts with mechanical precision. Those frozen seconds are the vulnerability.

contradictions: Despises corporate culture but has unconsciously adopted its efficiency metrics and self-optimization language

Preaches independence but is desperate for approval from people they respect

Eats the same meal before every job â€” superstition masquerading as preference

breaking_points: Discovering their employer deliberately sent them into a death trap

physical_description.heritage: Central Asian dominant (35.1%) with substantial Middle Eastern (27.0%), Sub-Saharan African (17.7%), Northern European (11.3%), and Eastern European (8.9%) ancestry. The genetic mix produces a distinctive polychromatic phenotype: Central Asian bone structure forms the foundationâ€”prominent cheekbones and angular jawâ€”while Middle Eastern features add depth to the face and warmth to coloring. Sub-Saharan African ancestry contributes the richness and luminosity of skin tone and subtle fullness to lips. Northern and Eastern European heritage introduces slight variations in eye shape and complexion texture. The result is a face that reads as genuinely pan-continental, belonging equally to multiple regions.
physical_description.build: Wiry and lean with corded muscle â€” built for speed and precision rather than power. Compact frame with minimal body fat; every movement economical and controlled.
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back in a tight braid, utilitarian â€” no ornament, designed for function during infiltration work
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown with subtle cybernetic gold rim at pupil edge â€” thermal masking system integration
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium-dark brown with golden-amber undertones and subtle reddish undertones in cheeksâ€”a genuine blend of Central Asian, Middle Eastern, and Sub-Saharan African genetics. Carries slight pallor from nocturnal living but retains natural warmth beneath. The tone suggests sun-kissed depth rather than uniformity.
physical_description.complexion: High, sculpted cheekbones characteristic of Central Asian and Northern Eurasian heritage; broad nasal bridge with slight flaring from Middle Eastern and African ancestry; lips slightly fuller than narrow Eurasian stereotypes. Face mapped with thin scar tissue â€” left cheekbone, across right temple, along jawline. Scars are old, healed clean but visible under certain light. Minimal facial hair; sparse and fine. Eyes carry exhaustion and calculation in equal measure, set deep with slight epicanthic folding from Eurasian heritage. Skin texture shows the slight variation in melanin distribution typical of multi-regional ancestry.

Hydraulic joint articulation visible at elbows and knees â€” subtle mechanical definition at joints, chrome accents where synthetic meets flesh. Movement reveals the augmentation: precision, inhuman fluidity in absorbing impact.
physical_description.posture_movement: Restless, economical. Never fully still â€” fingers tap, weight shifts, eyes scan. When moving with purpose, motion is silent and controlled, almost predatory. Sits with visibility of exits. Stands with weight on balls of feet, ready for vertical departure.

Boots are military-grade synthleather, scuffed but maintained. No jewelry. Augmentations deliberately left visible â€” signal of competence and warning.
